links.outcome: Primary-source rate and citation faithfulness of a retrieval-grounded drug QA agent versus next-best baselines
links.effect: DrugClaw primary-source rate 0.918 (+10.1 pp over next-best); faithfulness 0.887 (+5.9 pp); MedQA 0.920; PubMedQA 0.693.
links.quote: Across DrugAudit plus drug-related subsets of MedQA (751) and PubMedQA (512), DrugClaw is top-1 on every column of the headline table: composite Evidence Index under both judges, judge-mediated answer correctness, primary-source rate (0.918, +10.1 pp over next-best), faithfulness (0.887, +5.9 pp), MedQA (0.920), and PubMedQA (0.693).

unlisted_practices: Authority-aware benchmark scoring upstream-of-gold source match and citation faithfulness with dual LLM-as-judge
Multi-agent reflection-driven state-machine workflow querying a registry of pharmacovigilance skills

screen.reason: The paper develops and benchmarks a new multi-agent RAG system (DrugClaw) and an evaluation benchmark (DrugAudit) for drug information QA. It tests model/agent architecture performance rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
